archetypes.name: dyn-waterfall-state
archetypes.rationale: The multi-tier reducer and repository delta detection carry the highest behavioral risk.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect the changed lint-fix waterfall state machine. Focus on tier selection, reservation accounting, useful-delta handling after non-zero exits, and exact pre-ship versus ship-pr terminal routing. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
